spec.name: New annotation
spec.query: select text, test_id from events where "host" =~ /^$host$/ AND "test_id" =~ /^$test_id$/ AND $timeFilter

spec.title: Read Latency
spec.description: Среднее время чтения данных с жестких дисков

spec.query: SELECT mean("r_await_ms") AS "nvme0n1" FROM "diskmon" WHERE ("device"::tag = 'nvme0n1') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

spec.title: Write Latency
spec.description: Среднее время записи данных на жестких дисках

spec.query: SELECT mean("w_await_ms") AS "nvme0n1" FROM "diskmon" WHERE ("device"::tag = 'nvme0n1') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

spec.title: Read+Write Latency
spec.description: Среднее время чтения и записи данных на жестких дисках

spec.query: SELECT mean("await_ms") AS "nvme0n1" FROM "diskmon" WHERE ("device"::tag = 'nvme0n1') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

spec.title: % Usage Disk
spec.description: % занятости (загрузки) дисков

spec.query: SELECT mean("util_percent") AS "nvme0n1" FROM "diskmon" WHERE ("device"::tag = 'nvme0n1') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

spec.title: Queue average
spec.description: Средняя длина очереди запросов к диску

spec.query: SELECT mean("avgqu_sz") AS "sda" FROM "diskmon" WHERE ("device"::tag = 'sda') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
